name: Own-savings standing order the salary account cannot fund, 500 spare in another current account (G422)

expected.notes: G422 (Kevin 2026-11-06). Today Wed 25 Nov 2026, pay period last Friday, so payday is Fri 27 Nov and the window is 25 and 26 Nov. Barclays Current holds 50 and carries one own-savings standing order of 250 into Barclays Saver (savings, in no pool), dated Thu 26 Nov. Monzo Current holds 500 and has nothing due. Barclays: 50 - 250 = -200 after payments and at the low point, so the walk verdict is short. The only bounced item is a movement into savings, so it is never a payment at risk: at risk count 0, and the quiet unfunded-move item stays out because the order is not yet due. G422 treats the gap as a plan-like requirement on its source: gap 200, cover target ceil5(200) + 10 cushion = 210. Monzo headroom = 500 - 10 = 490 covers it alone, so one move of 210 from Monzo to Barclays. The saver the order pays into is never a source. Earmarks: Monzo set aside 210, Spend from 500 - 210 = 290. Barclays short after cover = max(0, 200 - 210) = 0 and carries the savings at risk fact (amount 200, covered by the move, not no-cover). Left to spend: the pool is the two counted current accounts 50 + 500 = 550 (the saver is in no pool), the 250 leaves the pool because its destination is not pooled, so 550 - 250 = 300. Allocation: Monzo 290 + Barclays 10 (its cushion, spendable only after the suggested move) = 300 exactly. Nothing is moved by the app: the card is a recommendation. The payday plan is unchanged (null): G402 says a habitual transfer is not a plan row. G438 (Kevin 2026-11-07), which supersedes the savings at risk reading above: there is no savings at risk state. The 250 order to the saver is an ordinary predicted payment on Barclays, so the 200 gap is an ordinary shortfall and gets an ordinary cover move. Every figure above is unchanged (after payments -200, move 210 from Monzo, Barclays 10 after the move, Monzo 290, Left to spend 300) and the saver is still not offered as the source of its own transfer. At risk count stays 0 because a bounced own-account movement is not a bill at risk. Only the savings_at_risk facts are gone.
